children: Solidion Technology Inc. (STI) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 02, 2026.

On August 31, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing the appointment of Messrs. Schwartz and Robinson and Ms. Ellen, the full text of which is filed herewith as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated herein by reference.

The information in this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1, is furnished and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or otherwise subject to liabilities under that section, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1881551/000121390026096770/ea0304469-8k_solidion.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1881551/000121390026096770/0001213900-26-096770-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
